dedupe_keys.name: voies velo du territoire de l ouest

description: Voies vélo du Territoire de l'Ouest is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data du TCO, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Réunion DRR - DEER - SRS. La Région Réunion, dans le cadre de la recherche d’une alternative au tout-automobile, aménage sa Voie Vélo Régionale (VVR). Coverage: Territoire de la Côte Ouest, La Réunion. The portal files it under Mobilité et transport. Its keywords are vélo, TCO, VoieVéloRégionale. The portal shows 112 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tco-re-portal.
